sources.snippet: Layerfault does not claim that static inspection can prove opaque neural weights are free from learned backdoors or malicious learned behaviour. Its job is to establish whether the model package you are about to use is structurally valid, intact where integrity data exists, sufficiently trusted, policy-compliant, and safe for the local runtime to admit.

sources.title: Releases: izm1chael/layerfault - GitHub
sources.snippet: Layerfault is an offline-first security and admission-control CLI for local AI models. It validates model structure and package contents, establishes integrity and package identity, evaluates provenance and local trust, applies operator policy, checks relevant runtime security advisories, and can block execution when those guarantees fail.
